title: Emerging role of deep learning-based artificial intelligence in tumor pathology

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Emerging role of deep learning-based artificial intelligence in tumor pathology》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The development of digital pathology and progression of state-of-the-art algorithms for computer vision have led to increasing interest in the use of artificial intelligence (AI), especially deep learning (DL)-based AI, in tumor pathology.

evidence.text: The development of digital pathology and progression of state-of-the-art algorithms for computer vision have led to increasing interest in the use of artificial intelligence (AI), especially deep learning (DL)-based AI, in tumor pathology.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Emerging role of deep learning-based artificial intelligence in tumor pathology》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】However, there are still some challenges relating to the implementation of AI, including the issues of algorithm validation and interpretability, computing systems, the unbelieving attitude of pathologists, clinicians and patients, as well as regulators and reimbursements.

evidence.text: However, there are still some challenges relating to the implementation of AI, including the issues of algorithm validation and interpretability, computing systems, the unbelieving attitude of pathologists, clinicians and patients, as well as regulators and reimbursements.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Emerging role of deep learning-based artificial intelligence in tumor pathology》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】The applications of AI in pathology not only contribute to improve diagnostic accuracy and objectivity but also reduce the workload of pathologists and subsequently enable them to spend additional time on high-level decision-making tasks.
